leaves.name: dsThm965Printed
leaves.doc: Diamond-Shurman, GTM 228 (2005), Thm 9.6.5 (k >= 2; Deligne 1971; Shimura 1971 Thm 7.14 for k = 2; numbering UNVERIFIED), printed form: for a normalized eigenform f in S_k(N, chi) (DS Def 5.8.1) with number field K_f and a prime lambda of O_{K_f} over l, a continuous rho_{f,lambda} : G_Q -> GL_2(K_{f,lambda}) (Mathlib's adicCompletion), unramified outside lN, with rho(Frob_p) having characteristic polynomial (or satisfying) x^2 - a_p x + chi(p) p^(k-1) over K_f. Either printed wording gives it by or-introduction; no coefficient dictionary (coeff-ext).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (DS 9.6.5 over K_{f,lambda} as printed, DS Def 5.8.1 eigenforms, either wording by or-introduction); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Diamond-Shurman, GTM 228, Thm 9.6.5 (Deligne 1971; Shimura 1971 Thm 7.14 for k = 2), printed form over K_{f,lambda}: rho_{f,lambda}(Frob_p) has characteristic polynomial (or satisfies) x^2 - a_p x + chi(p) p^(k-1)

leaves.name: gamma1IntegralSpan
leaves.doc: Shimura, Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions (1971), Thm 3.52 (number UNVERIFIED; also Diamond-Im 1995 section 12.3, Diamond-Shurman section 6.5 for k = 2): S_k(Gamma_1(N)) has a basis of cusp forms whose Fourier coefficients at infinity are rational integers. Consequence taken: for k >= 2, S_k(Gamma_1(N)) (Mathlib CuspForm on Gamma1 N) is spanned over C by forms with integral q-expansion (period 1). With diamondPreservesIntegral it gives the Q(chi)-structure of S_k(N, chi) and K_f a number field (coeff-field, all glue proved).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Shimura 1971 Thm 3.52, integral basis of S_k(Gamma_1(N)), basis => span, k >= 2); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Shimura 1971, Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions, Thm 3.52: S_k(Gamma_1(N)) has a basis with rational integral Fourier coefficients

leaves.name: diamondIntegralToRational
leaves.doc: The diamond operators are defined over Q, weakest form: for k >= 2 and d in (Z/NZ)^x, Tau Ceti's diamondOpCusp k d (slash by gamma in Gamma_0(N) with lower-right entry = d mod N) maps a cusp form on Gamma_1(N) with integral q-expansion to one with rational q-expansion. Source: the Hecke algebra Z[T_n, <d>] preserves S_k(Gamma_1(N), Z) (Diamond-Im 1995 sections 12.3-12.4; Shimura 1971 section 3.5 with Thm 3.52; Diamond-Shurman section 6.5 for k = 2; all locators UNVERIFIED). Consequence taken: integral input, rational output, k >= 2, so it follows from the print whether it states stability of S_k(Gamma_1(N), A) for A = Z, Z[1/N] or Q (coeff-field).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (the <d> part of 'T_Z = Z[T_n, <d>] preserves S_k(Gamma_1(N), Z)', weakened to integral input, rational output); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Diamond-Im 1995, Modular forms and modular curves, sections 12.3-12.4 (Shimura 1971 section 3.5; Diamond-Shurman section 6.5 for k = 2): the diamond operators preserve S_k(Gamma_1(N), Z)

leaves.name: dsThm966Printed
leaves.doc: Deligne-Serre, Formes modulaires de poids 1, Ann. Sci. ENS (4) 7 (1974), Thm 4.1 with (4.1.1), p. 514 (locator UNVERIFIED; Diamond-Shurman Thm 9.6.6 restates it), as printed: for f != 0 a (cusp) form of type (1, eps) with eps(-1) = -1 that is an eigenvector of the T_p, p not dividing N, with eigenvalues a_p (Tau Ceti EigenformAwayFromLevel N 1, no normalization a_1 = 1), a continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(C) with finite image, unramified outside N, with tr rho(Frob_p) = a_p (the T_p-eigenvalue F.eigenvalue p) and det rho(Frob_p) = eps(p). The coefficient form a_p = coeff g p (from a_1 = 1) and eps(-1) = -1 (parity lemma, TauCeti Parity.lean:113) are glue in DSThm966EV.dsThm966_of_printed (coeff-fix).

leaves.source: Deligne-Serre 1974 Thm 4.1 (4.1.1), p. 514: f != 0 of type (1, eps), eigenvector of T_p (p not dividing N) with eigenvalues a_p => rho : G_Q -> GL_2(C), unramified outside N, Tr rho(Frob_p) = a_p, det rho(Frob_p) = eps(p)
